{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = completed_orders['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Remove QA orders
completed_valid = completed_orders[~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue without QA orders
mean_revenue_valid = completed_valid['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the number of completed orders and valid completed orders
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(completed_orders)}")
print(f"Number of valid completed orders (excluding QA): {len(completed_valid)}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue_valid:.2f}")"}
